cohort: The study included 664 women who presented in spontaneous labor at term between 2015 and 2016 and underwent AROM during the active stage of labor.
finding: Nonreassuring FHR after AROM during delivery was associated with parity, fetal station at AROM, birthweight, and oxytocin augmentation.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight was significantly lower in the nonreassuring FHR group (3201 +/- 418 vs 3342 +/- 376 g, P < .001)
